clock.first: dedicated ingress callback first operation CheckedClockRead before get_cb_info/Product/locks/parse
clock.ordering: single synchronous ingress and owner each check causal reads; no global max across concurrently sampled timestamps
clock.suspendLimit: unreported suspend wall age not guaranteed

ingress.channel: one synchronous UI .onTouch channel; no promise/worker/async repost
ingress.busy: try-lock/atomic gate failure cancels active stroke through invalidation generation
ingress.ABI: g9RxTouchIngress(raw64:Uint32Array):string; no JS receipt timestamp, force or verified boolean
ingress.typedArray: T629/T630 fixed provider unit profile, strict exact64/uint32/offset0 backing256; UNKNOWN safely rejects

locking: clock first with no protocol lock
release mutex and ingress gate before return
GL owner never calls GL/IO/loader under protocol mutex
render/transport/Capture callbacks recheck outside GL and acquire only same protocol mutex

FIFO.expiry: owner maintain before claim; expired in-flight retired before exact-slot pop
FIFO.dedupe: compare original semantic words, not hash; queued/claimed/lastConsumed known duplicates ACK; older unretained keys STALE, never replay
FIFO.source: same FIFO, native command serial; separate meaningful source intent, impulse never rearms BLOCKED
